"''All ships.|[[Cut Lawquane]] and [[Hunter]]|}} The '''clone impound vessel''',{{TBB|Cut and Run}} {{AD|Disney+}} also known as the '''tow truck''',{{SW|url=cut-and-run-concept-art-gallery|text="Cut and Run" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} was a type of [[starship]] utilized by the [[clone trooper]]s of the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Starship|vessel]] featured two frontward-facing arms that could be used to seize starships.
